summary: Villas and apartments close to the city with a named general manager are strengths, but repeated lists, conflicting facts and booking only through an outside system appear to cost you residents.

findings.problem: The villa and apartment lists appear three times, and View Available Units, Explore residences and Explore Residences all go to one page.
findings.cost: Repeated lists and duplicate buttons bury what a tenant needs.
findings.fix: One clean listing with clear filters.

findings.problem: The page claims 23 swimming pools while the general manager mentions a semi olympic swimming pool, and it calls itself both a resort and a compound.
findings.cost: Conflicting claims make visitors doubt your facilities.
findings.fix: One verified list of facilities and one name.

findings.problem: The only form is a newsletter field, booking goes to an outside system, and the Residents Portal link uses plain http on a dynamic address.
findings.cost: Prospects have no easy enquiry form, and an insecure link harms trust.
findings.fix: An on site enquiry and viewing form and a secure portal link.

findings.problem: The page shows one testimonial from Robert with no date, award logos with no names, and image text such as Evgen.
findings.cost: Thin proof and leftover labels weaken a premium offer.
findings.fix: Dated resident reviews and named awards.

redesign: One clean listing for villas and apartments.
An on site enquiry form, WhatsApp and viewing booking.
Verified facilities, dated reviews and named awards.
